content: Apologies if this is answered somewhere, I did browse through the site and this channel but I didn't see anything about this. Is there a guideline on build times? The one I'm preparing for submission right now contains 86 or so semantic modules that take about 35 minutes cold, and then there are several large finite certificate files that use kernel checked decide which bring the total build time after final composition to around 2 hours (at least on my local machine). I'm running it all through some optimization passes, but obviously want to be mindful of resource constraints.
Anything less than a 5 hour build on a standard Github runner should be fine. We'll work out how to handle larger submissions.

Kim Morrison said:

Anything less than a 5 hour build on a standard Github runner should be fine. We'll work out how to handle larger submissions.

Initial build took ~1h24m on the runner, then comparator/nanoda took ~2h34m. But I'm looking into some optimizations to cut down the certificate time anyways. Will submit it after that work is done, thanks.
